personality_one_liner: A calm, structured, and highly secure environment that balances professional authority with empathetic wellness tracking for uniformed forces.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Ensure buttons and inputs are not cramped, use hitSlop for small icons.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on featured/hero card overlays over imagery
Ensure text readability by using translucent tint under the blur
dont's: Never apply to standard list rows
Do not over-stack (max 2 glass surfaces per screen)

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A secure, identifier-first authentication portal for both Personnel and Therapists.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a 'Verifying credentials...' text.
states.error: Readable inline error message or toast showing login failure.

screens.layout: Clean, full-screen structure with an identifier-first flow (Service ID or Email first, then password). Use ample padding, a deep teal abstract hero background in the upper half with gradient-to-dark scrim, and modular input fields below to establish trust and professional authority.

screens.name: PersonnelHome
screens.purpose: A calming daily dashboard showing stress history, current risk level, and quick wellness metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the chart and wellness cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a calm nature scene with a prompt to 'Start your first wellness check'.
states.error: Failed to load data message with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Organ-based grouping. A featured hero card at the top displaying the overall Wellness Risk Level (Low/Medium/High) with a glassmorphic overlay. Below it, a line chart showing stress history, followed by a grid (2-col) of today's metrics (Sleep, Workload, Mood) using visual data representation instead of raw numbers.

screens.name: WellnessAssessment
screens.purpose: A focused, low-stress 10+ question check-in to evaluate personal and work-related well-being.

states.error: Could not submit assessment, Retry button.

screens.layout: Single column card layout. One question per screen with large, tappable option chips or sliders. A sticky 'Next' primary CTA anchored at the bottom (inside a fixed container avoiding keyboard/scroll issues).

screens.name: RiskResult
screens.purpose: Actionable feedback screen explaining the wellness score and providing a clear support pathway.
screens.layout: Hero layout with a solid top section indicating risk tier via color (Soft Green for Low, Warning for Medium, Error for High), followed by a breakdown list of 'Top Contributing Factors'. A sticky primary CTA at the bottom connects them to the suggested support pathway (AI Chat, Tips, or Counsellor).

screens.name: AIChat
screens.purpose: A friendly, conversational interface providing motivational support.

states.empty: Calm abstract therapist illustration in the center with a 'How are you feeling today?' prompt.
states.error: Connection error banner at top, Retry button.

screens.layout: Standard chat interface. A sticky header with a back button. Messages wrapped in brandTertiary for AI and brandPrimary for user. Input field sticky at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: WearableConnect
screens.purpose: Sync hub for smartwatches to pull live heart rate and sleep data.

states.empty: Minimalist smartwatch tracker illustration, prompt to 'Pair a device'.
states.error: Could not connect to device, Retry button.

screens.layout: List-based layout of available devices. Large hero image at the top of a smartwatch on a white background, followed by a single-column list of Bluetooth/wearable connections.

screens.name: TherapistDashboard
screens.purpose: A clinical overview tool for therapists to manage high-risk personnel and track trends.

states.loading: Skeleton list for the risk pool.
states.error: Failed to sync patient data, Retry button.

screens.layout: Minimalist, data-dense view. Uses tabs or segmented controls for 'Alerts', 'Trends', and 'Follow-up'. Uses list rows with clear visual indicators for risk status. Anonymized identifiers in place of names for privacy.

personnel_home_empty.alt: A smooth gradient shifting from light green to soft teal

ai_chat_empty.alt: Abstract composition of layered brown and beige brushstrokes on a light background

wearable_connect_hero.alt: a white apple watch sitting on top of a black surface

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Deep Teal/Navy is the primary brand color, supported by Soft Green for success/wellness highlights. Do not use generic AI-blue or purple.
Implement an identifier-first login flow. Avoid single-screen multi-input if possible, to enhance the feeling of professional security.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text, maintaining strict font weight limits (max 500). Use size for hierarchy, not bold weights.
Ensure the Personnel Home dashboard uses visual representation for metrics (progress rings, trend lines) rather than raw numerical data.
For any text placed on background imagery (e.g., login hero), you must apply a vertical 3-stop gradient scrim (transparent to dark) to guarantee WCAG contrast ratios.
Ensure primary CTA buttons are always sticky at the bottom of the screen above the home indicator, outside of the scroll view.
Include empty, loading, and error states for all data-fetching screens (Dashboard, Risk Results). Ensure empty states use the provided imagery or calm illustrations.
